definitions.explanation: Something that was not anticipated or predicted; outside of what was expected.

examples.japanese: {予想外|よそうがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
{予想外|よそうがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{早|はや}く→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
{予想外|よそうがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by the unexpected development.

examples.japanese: {予想外|よそうがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: Due to unexpected popularity, the product sold out immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予想外|よそうがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大差|たいさ}→大差：08410_taisa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なるとは→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{思|おも}っていなかった→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: The match was decided by an unexpectedly large margin. No one thought it would turn out like this.

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧ (expectation) + ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {予想外|よそうがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + Noun (unexpected ~)
- {予想外|よそうがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (unexpectedly)
- {予想外|よそうがい}だ (it's unexpected)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧ (unexpected, surprising)
- ⟦{思|おも}いがけない→思いがけない：19375_omoigakenai⟧ (unexpected)
- ⟦{予期|よき}→予期：03662_yoki⟧⟦せぬ→する：00392_suru⟧ (unforeseen)

CAN BE POSITIVE OR NEGATIVE: {予想外|よそうがい} simply indicates deviation from expectations, regardless of whether the outcome is good or bad.
